title: Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.12016v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many real-world applications require language models to internalize knowledge that was absent from pretraining, to incorporate continually updated facts, or to learn new domain skills. Self-distillation has emerged as a natural approach for this task. A model conditioned on the source material acts as the teacher, and an unconditioned student is trained to reproduce the teacher's behavior closed-book. We propose Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD), an efficient per-token mixed-policy method for self-distillation. The student generates each rollout by default, while the teacher intervenes only at positions where its next-token distribution substantially diverges from the student's. Unlike off-policy distillation with teacher-generated prefixes, this design keeps training rollouts close to the student's test-time behavior, while avoiding the low-signal states that fully on-policy rollouts drift into. translated_title: 推测式自蒸馏实现高效的知识内化
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的应用要求语言模型能够内化预训练中缺失的知识、纳入持续更新的事实，或学习新的领域技能。自蒸馏已成为完成这一任务的一种自然方法：以源材料为条件的模型充当教师，而无条件的学生模型则被训练以“闭卷”方式复现教师的行为。我们提出了推测式自蒸馏（Speculative Self-Distillation，SSD），这是一种高效的逐 token 混合策略自蒸馏方法。默认情况下由学生模型生成每个 rollout，而教师模型仅在其下一个 token 分布与学生模型出现显著分歧的位置进行干预。与使用教师生成前缀的离策略蒸馏不同，这种设计使训练 rollout 保持在接近学生测试时行为的分布上，同时避免了完全在策略 rollout 容易陷入的低信号状态。实际上，SSD 让教师……
tldr: 提出推测式自蒸馏（SSD）——一种逐 token 混合策略方法：默认由学生生成 rollout，教师仅在下一个 token 分布显著分歧处介入，既贴近学生的测试时行为分布又避免低信号状态，从而实现更高效的知识内化。
en_tdlr: Speculative Self-Distillation (SSD) is an efficient per-token mixed-policy self-distillation method where the student generates rollouts by default and the teacher intervenes only at positions of substantial next-token divergence, keeping training on the student's test-time distribution while avoiding low-signal states, thereby enabling efficient knowledge internalization.
